items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: the four Harlem All-Stars which was Chuck Green, Baby Lawrence, Jimmy Sly, and Kind Sir

ctx.x: Well, that was Bert Gibson and the famous Gibson family; and Buster Brown of the Harlem All-Stars -- the four Harlem All-Stars which was Chuck Green, Baby Lawrence, Jimmy Sly, and Kind Sir, who was Buster Brown. That was for George Wein, see.
How did the other dancers react to these guys leaving to go to the Olympics?
